sensors.guide: Angular lint must pass; fix the code rather than the rule.
The app must typecheck before the turn ends.
Run the component and service specs before claiming done; fix the code, never the specs.

sensors.cmd: if [ -f .rig/gen/dependency-cruiser.cjs ]; then npx --no-install depcruise src --config .rig/gen/dependency-cruiser.cjs --ignore-known .rig/gen/known-violations.json --output-type err; fi
sensors.guide: Respect the approved layers in architecture.md; do not import across a forbidden boundary.

sensors.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d) && npx --yes jscpd@5.4.2 src --silent --reporters json --output "$d" >&2 && node -p "try{require('$d/jscpd-report.json').statistics.total.percentage}catch{0}"
sensors.guide: Reuse existing components and services instead of copying them; the duplicated share may not grow past its baseline.
Do not add dependencies with known high-severity vulnerabilities.
Specs must assert behaviour so that changing the code makes them fail.
